en.html:
The main gate was behind us almost before it could become a main gate problem.
The guards could apparently do nothing but blink and open their mouths at the sudden bombardment.

Soft fellows. No vigilance. To say such things would have been unfair. A little time to finish blinking, at least.

en.html:
The Ootori main residence at Sasagawa was truly vast. From the gate to the inner residence, several kilometres, surely.
At this rate, however, even those kilometres would be disposed of in no time.

Knowing the way was not the mystery. Unknown territory for me; for the two Ootori women, home only. Of course they knew the layout.
The speed was another matter. That one could not be dismissed with of course.
A hundred kilometres an hour—or approaching a hundred and fifty?

And at that speed, hardly a shake. Call it excellent driving? No. We had crossed excellence and entered abnormality.
The old Prince Henry, that celebrated motorcar, skimmed the ground like wind.

Guards along the way could only watch this aristocratic traffic offence go past. Occasionally a unit understood quickly enough to spread out across our path, but—

篠川の大鳥本家邸宅は実に広大であり、正門から奥
屋敷まで数キロの道のりはあるに違いない。
　しかし、この分ではそれこそあっという間だろう。

　道筋を迷わない点に不思議はなかった。俺にとって
は未知の地でも、大鳥主従にすればここは<ruby>我が家<rt>ホーム</rt></ruby>。
　構造を把握していて当然だ。

　当然で済まないのはこの速度である。
　時速一〇〇キロ――あるいは一五〇キロに迫ろうか。

　これだけの速度を出しながら然程の揺れもないのは、
見事というより、もはや異様と評するべきだった。

　たまに、状況判断の早い隊が行く手に展開しても、

en.html:
Kageaki"This is absolutely not done."
Sayo"Certainly. Simply not done."
Kanae"Really, not done at all."
Kageaki"............"
Kageaki"All three in agreement. Then how, exactly, did we agree on driving straight through the front?"
Sayo"Happened as we went along, I believe."
Kanae"Perhaps the car reached Sasagawa before the plan did? We were still thinking, no?"
Kageaki"But reaching the place is not an instruction to drive straight into it..."
Sayo"Entirely correct, Minato sir. Such wisdom should be supplied a little earlier. After entering, what use is do not enter?"
Kanae"Exactly. Kageaki, what a troublesome man you are."
Kageaki"..................In future, I shall bear this in mind."
